facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition says stakeholders from administration, private sector, academia and civil society met at the Virtual University in Ouagadougou on 17 June 2026 and validated the national AI roadmap 2026-2030, drafted by SPIVTEN; no cabinet approval or government launch is stated.
